answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 482 Country: India Title: Please guide me with references of Quran and Hadith the exact timings of Asr prayers. Question: Please guide me with references of Quran and Hadith the exact timings of Asr prayers (start and last time) Answer ID: 482 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 655/J) According to Hanafi Fiqh, the time of Asr starts from Misl-e-Sani (when the shadow of every object become double after its original shadow) and ends at sunset. For reference and details, please see Ilaus Sunan and Fathul Mulhim. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
